g.text: Tiny, winged creatures with a mischievous nature.
They ﬂit through meadows, casting illusions and
playing tricks on wanderers for their own
to play mostly harmless tricks on mortals.
glittering trails, darting figures, ﬂeeting glimpses
airy giggling, fluttering of tiny wings, melodic chimes
delicate nectar, lavender and jasmine, sugary aroma
